messages:
sam: Quick check — can we hold PR #18234 until tomorrow's rebase window? CI backlog is ~6h and there's a deploy freeze starting 17:00 UTC today. cc @devon @alejandro

devon: link? I can try to get a rerun queued. If it's flaky we might need a full rerun not just rerun-failed.

sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/18234 — failing on windows-matrix and the integration stage. I think a rebase will help (merge-base diverged). :eyes: 

alejandro: I can take a look, but heads up I'm OOO after 16:00 UTC. If you want it merged before freeze, we need approvals + green CI in next 90m.

ci-bot: Build 18234.1 queued on linux-ubuntu-22, windows-matrix queued, macos queued. Estimated queue time: ~3h.

devon: ok re-run queued for all. If tests keep failing, propose: hold merge, schedule rebase window Mon 08:00 UTC, mark PR as 'hold/rebase-needed'.

sam: Rebase command I used locally:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout pr/18234
git rebase origin/main
``` 
worked locally but CI still failing for windows.

devon: If dev repros locally we can patch test flakiness or skip flaky test for now. @ops-kate any objections to delaying merge until Monday's rebase window?

ops-kate: Hold is fine. We can't risk breaking the freeze. Please add a short note in the PR and set the label `hold:rebase-window` :thumbsup: 

sam: Done — label added and comment with repro steps. Thanks all :pray: 

alejandro: I left a small fix suggestion to stabilize integration test (nit). Will open patch if there's no time today.

devon: I'll watch CI and queue a focused rerun if any new failures show up, otherwise we'll pick this up in the Monday slot. :eyes: 

ci-bot: Build 18234.2 started on linux-ubuntu-22 (rerun by devon)

sam: Appreciate it — setting calendar block Mon 08:00-09:00 UTC for rebase window.

ops-kate: noted, adding to maintenance schedule.
